svg.title: Every limit in integers
svg.desc: Four panels. Speed: a square component cap and a disc vector cap compared with squared integers, so no square root is needed. Rate: a token bucket in millionths of an intent, refilled only from positive elapsed monotonic time. Slew: a bound proportional to elapsed time and capped at the nominal period. Duty: overlapping command horizons are counted once as a union of half-open intervals.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: refill = rmHz · Δtns / 106 millionths of an intent, from elapsed monotonic time only
2 Hz for 250 ms: 500,000, half an intent; remainders are carried exactly
bound = maximum acceleration × elapsed ms / 1000, rounded down;
zero if the clock moves backwards; capped at the nominal period
summing horizons counts overlaps twice; a fixed ring can drop
an active interval. Exact nanoseconds: 5,900,000,001 ns plus
100 ms exceeds a 6,000 ms cap by 1 ns, yet rounded milliseconds
give exactly 6,000 and would allow it
